summary: You offer dispute and corporate work in several languages with a WhatsApp number, but broken buttons and unfinished text hide your strengths.

findings.problem: The Contact us button in the second hero block links to /about/, and View More under the blog cards links to /about/ too.
findings.cost: A client who clicks to contact you is sent to the wrong page.
findings.fix: Contact buttons that open a form or WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The Our Blogs cards show the placeholder image and the line LAW TIME Legal Consultants is a TIME Legal Consultants is a UAE repeated four times.
findings.cost: A garbled blog section makes the firm look unfinished.
findings.fix: Real posts or no blog section.

findings.problem: There is no contact form, no client testimonials and no named lawyers.
findings.cost: Clients want to know who will act for them and what others say.
findings.fix: Enquiry form, testimonials and lawyer profiles.

findings.problem: Typos such as We offers a comprehensive range, including rental and all. and Arabic,Hindi. The claim Best Law firm in Abu Dhabi has no evidence.
findings.cost: Errors and unsupported claims lower trust.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and evidence for claims.

redesign: Contact buttons that work, an enquiry form and a clear WhatsApp option.
Lawyer profiles, client testimonials and a clean, proofread site.
